title: Dew and Frost Risk on Optics
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography capture software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — logging to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=observatory:env
| eval dew_gap=ambient_c-dewpoint_c
| stats latest(dew_gap) as gap, latest(ambient_c) as temp
| eval dewing=if(gap<2,1,0), frost=if(temp<0 AND gap<2,1,0)
description: Warns when conditions are about to fog or frost your optics so the dew heaters come on before the night is lost.
value: Dew on a lens ends imaging instantly; a dew-point margin warning triggers heaters in time to keep the glass clear.
implementation: Ingest temperature and dew point into `index=personal`; alert when the margin closes toward dewing or frost.
visualization: Single-value dew-margin gauge with a warning band.
grandmaExplanation: It warns when your telescope lens is about to fog up or frost over, so you can turn on the heaters in time.
